title.narrative: Strengthen international cooperation in ocean science, and sustainable ocean planning and management in the Western Pacific and adjacent areas

description.narrative:
The ocean in the Western Pacific and its adjacent regions is of immense environmental, social, cultural, and economic importance, sustaining the livelihoods, food security, prosperity, and well-being of hundreds of millions of people. At the same time, the ocean is increasingly confronted with complex and interconnected challenges, including climate change, marine pollution, biodiversity loss, overexploitation of marine resources, and coastal degradation, many of which transcend national boundaries and are far beyond the capacity of any single nation to address alone.
This activity aims to bring together Member States in the region to strengthen the ocean science-policy interface, enhance international cooperation in marine science and ocean management, and promote consensus-building on cooperative approaches for the sustainable management and governance of the ocean through the IOC Sub-Commission for the Western Pacific (WESTPAC).
Through this activity, the leadership role of UNESCO and IOC in advancing ocean science, scientific cooperation, capacity development, and sustainable ocean planning and management in the region will be further strengthened, while fostering enhanced collaboration, knowledge exchange, and partnerships among Member States.
